app.name: HKSDPCL Studio
app.council: Hong Kong Survival and Disaster Prevention Council
app.subtitle: AI content studio
app.logoAlt: Hong Kong Survival and Disaster Prevention Council logo

format.subtitle: This locks the aspect ratio for the whole generation pipeline and lets you refine the idea and visuals next
format.storyDesc: Best for Instagram Stories — vertical full-bleed visuals
format.postDesc: Best for Feed posts — square or landscape

placeholder.title: Next: Input idea
placeholder.body: This step lands in a later phase and you can go back to change the format or start a new project

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Manage your Poe connection, model choices, language, and appearance in one place
settings.generalDescription: Add the API key used to connect HKSDPCL Studio with Poe
settings.poeDescription: Your key is kept locally in this app and is hidden by default
settings.modelsDescription: Enter the exact Poe model name for each stage and use any model available in your Poe account

models.ideaDescription: Turn a starting thought into a usable content idea
models.briefDescription: Shape the idea into a structured creative direction
models.imagesDescription: Create or refine the visual direction for the project
models.captionDescription: Write captions and prepare the voice or audio direction

settings.appearanceDescription: Choose how the studio looks and which language it uses
settings.themeDescription: Switch between a light and dark workspace
settings.languageDescription: Choose the language used throughout the studio

characters.title: Characters
characters.listDescription: Manage the characters used across your projects
characters.emptyDescription: Create a character to keep its images and background in one place
characters.backgroundPlaceholder: Describe the character's world, place, atmosphere, and visual details

context.title: Pipeline context
context.description: This choice stays locked across the project
context.referenceTip: Add a reference image when the visual direction needs a starting point

idea.title: Start with an idea
idea.description: Give the agent a rough thought and it will shape the first creative direction
idea.promptDescription: Paste a brief, a sentence, or a rough content request
idea.promptPlaceholder: For example a short survival tip series for families preparing for typhoon season
idea.referenceTip: Reference images help the agent understand the mood, setting, or visual language

brief.title: Review the creative brief
brief.description: Edit any part of the draft before moving into image generation
brief.regenerated: A fresh brief draft is ready to review

defaults.summary: A practical and encouraging public safety story that turns preparation into a simple action people can remember
defaults.visualDirection: Clean editorial composition with warm natural light, confident subjects, clear gestures, and a calm orange accent
defaults.imagePrompt: Editorial social media image showing a family preparing a compact emergency kit on a bright kitchen table, documentary realism, calm confident mood, clean composition, high detail
defaults.captionDirection: Keep the caption useful and reassuring with one memorable action and a simple call to prepare today

images.title: Generate the visual
images.description: Create variations, compare the direction, and keep refining the prompt until one feels right
images.promptHint: The prompt can be edited and regenerated at any time

gallery.title: Review the gallery
gallery.description: Choose the image that will carry the story into the final caption and audio

caption.title: Add caption and audio
caption.description: Choose a caption, make your edits, and optionally create a voiceover

options.one: A small preparation today can make a big difference when the weather changes
options.two: Keep the essentials close, keep the plan simple, and help your family feel ready
options.three: Prepared does not have to be complicated — start with one useful kit and one clear conversation

caption.audioDescription: Send the selected caption to an audio model when the post needs a spoken layer

export.title: Ready to export
export.description: Review the final package and download the assets when the project is ready
export.caption: Caption
